blocks.text: ILOILO CITY — Air quality in Metro Iloilo deteriorated to a level considered unhealthy for sensitive groups on Sunday, as authorities continued to monitor haze possibly linked to smoke from forest fires in Indonesia. The Department of Environment and Natural Resources-Environmental Management Bureau (DENR-EMB) Region 6 said its Continuous Ambient Air Quality Monitoring Station at the Garden of Love in Barangay Nabitasan, La Paz, recorded a rolling 24-hour Air Quality Index (AQI) of 115 for PM2.5 as of noon Sunday. An AQI of 115 placed PM2.5, or fine particulate matter measuring 2.5 micrometers or smaller, in the “unhealthy for sensitive groups” […]...
